text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi।
Fasle the ya khamoshi ki koi deewar thi,
Par is adhoori si daastaan mein bhi,
Ek alag hi mohabbat ki bahaar thi।
title: Unkahee Baatein
description: A heartfelt poetry about silent love and unexpressed feelings that linger in the heart forever.
